captions.instagram:
How does a water sprinkler work?

The tick-tick-tick sprinkler has no motor: its own jet throws an arm aside, a spring swings it back, and every tap turns the head three degrees. Watch that happen in slow motion, see why sprinklers must overlap, and find out why a fire sprinkler never sets off its neighbours.

→ How does a sprinkler work? This one has no motor: the water passing through it does everything.
→ A riser, a bearing, a nozzle, and a swinging arm with a spoon that sits in the jet.
→ The nozzle trades pressure for speed. At 3 bar the jet leaves at 23 metres a second.
→ The jet hits the spoon and flings the arm aside. A spring swings it back to strike the body: tick.
→ Each tick turns the head about three degrees. A trip lever flips at the end of the arc and it chatters back.

Play with it yourself. It's free and open source: glassbox.how/sprinklerclear (link in bio)

youtubeLong.title: How does a water sprinkler work? (interactive explainer)
youtubeLong.description:
The tick-tick-tick sprinkler has no motor: its own jet throws an arm aside, a spring swings it back, and every tap turns the head three degrees. Watch that happen in slow motion, see why sprinklers must overlap, and find out why a fire sprinkler never sets off its neighbours.

▶ Play with the interactive version: https://glassbox.how/e/sprinklerclear/
⌘ Source code (MIT): https://github.com/bdeeps/sprinklerclear

In this video:
• No motor, just water. An impact sprinkler is a riser pipe, a bearing the head turns in, a nozzle tilted up at about 25 degrees, and a spring-loaded arm with a spoon that sits in the jet.
• Pressure becomes speed, and air decides the throw. The nozzle turns pressure into speed: v = 0.96 × √(2P/ρ), about 23.6 m/s at 3 bar, the push of a tank 31 m up.
• Tick: the arm strikes the body. The jet hits the spoon and flings the arm aside.
• One sprinkler waters badly, many water well. A single sprinkler puts down most of its water close in and little at the rim.
• Flood, sprinkler or drip. To get the same water to the roots you pump need ÷ efficiency.
• The fire sprinkler is a different machine. Each fire sprinkler head is a valve held shut by a glass bulb of liquid that shatters at its rated temperature, 68 °C for a red bulb.
